tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The world, modals and the chat transcript. The model sits on plain white.

tokens.name: floor
tokens.usage: The build floor inside its dot grid.

tokens.name: unit
tokens.usage: Control units: every grey housing that holds keys, the chat panel, popovers.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Inset track behind a two-option control.

tokens.name: key-line
tokens.usage: Borders on white keys and the text field.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers in lists.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Floor dot grid and the stippled site (house, trees, pool).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, rules under titles, numbers on finished steps.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text and unpressed key labels.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, column heads. 5.7:1 on paper, 5.1:1 on unit.

tokens.name: key-dark
tokens.usage: Primary keys: Build it, Next step, Send.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Braun orange. Means one thing: selected, or what Claude is working on right now. Dots, knobs, outlines, the Talk key, and the top two stress bands (fill). Never body text on white.

tokens.name: signal-pressed
tokens.usage: The Talk key while held.

tokens.name: wood
tokens.usage: Framing lumber on the model. Only the model gets colour.

tokens.name: concrete
tokens.usage: Slabs and footings on the model.

tokens.name: stress-1
tokens.usage: Stress view fill, 0–20% of the limit. The three low bands are greys so the eye goes to the orange.

tokens.name: stress-2
tokens.usage: Stress view fill, 20–40% of the limit.

tokens.name: stress-3
tokens.usage: Stress view fill, 40–60% of the limit.

tokens.name: stress-4
tokens.usage: Stress view fill, 60–80% of the limit: light orange.

tokens.name: stress-5
tokens.usage: Stress view fill, 80–100% of the limit: signal orange as a fill (selection stays an outline). Over 100% is ink with paper hatching and a warning mark; parts not checked are paper at 25%.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Modal titles: Materials, Projects, Build steps.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Spec values under the project name.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Labels on keys; 600 when pressed. Raised from 13px to 14px for LOC-104 accessibility (14px minimum text).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Titles over controls, captions, who said what. Raised from 12px to 14px for LOC-104 accessibility (14px minimum text).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between keys inside a unit; unit padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between units.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside panels; chat panel padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen edge inset for floating units and modals.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between list groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margin inside modals.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Keys inside units and tracks.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text field, Talk key.

tokens.name: radius-unit
tokens.usage: Small control units.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Floors unit, popovers, cards.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Chat panel, modals, mobile sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dots, chips, swatches.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The white piece on the chosen option.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: A latched key, such as Materials while its modal is open.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and sheets over the model.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for every key, on desktop and phone (LOC-104; the phone mockup drew 40px).

tokens.name: size-talk
tokens.usage: Height of the Talk key and the text field beside it.

tokens.name: size-chat-panel
tokens.usage: Chat panel width on desktop.

tokens.name: size-chat-panel-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest the fluid chat panel gets between the phone breakpoint and full desktop.

tokens.name: size-swatch
tokens.usage: Round material swatch dot.

tokens.name: size-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Width and offset of the ink focus ring on every focusable control.

tokens.name: breakpoint-phone
tokens.usage: Below this width the app uses the phone layout (chat as a sheet). Emitted as a TS constant, since CSS variables cannot be used inside @media.

tokens.name: motion-knob
tokens.usage: The floor slider knob sliding to a stop.

tokens.name: motion-snap
tokens.usage: The chosen-option piece snapping across, with a small overshoot.

tokens.name: motion-sheet
tokens.usage: Phone bottom sheet opening and the model sliding up.
